cs_pin.docs:
**int**: The SPI chip select pin to use

*See also: [MCP23Sxx I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/mcp23Sxx#configuration-variables)*

deviceaddress.docs:
**int**: The address of the chip. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [MCP23Sxx I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/mcp23Sxx#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this MCP23S08 component.

*See also: [MCP23Sxx I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/mcp23Sxx#configuration-variables)*

interrupt_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin connected to the INT output of the MCP23S08. When configured, the component becomes interrupt-driven instead of polling — it only reads the chip when a pin actually changes state, significantly reducing SPI bus traffic and CPU usage. Must be an internal GPIO pin (not another expander pin).

*See also: [MCP23Sxx I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/mcp23Sxx#configuration-variables)*

open_drain_interrupt.docs:
**boolean**: Configure interrupt pins to open-drain mode. Useful when the MCP23S08's power supply is greater than 3.3 volts. Note that these pins will require pull-up resistors (to 3.3 volts) when this mode is enabled.

*See also: [MCP23Sxx I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/mcp23Sxx#configuration-variables)*
